Name: Fairy Berry
Author: EnbyFelix
Description:
Adds a magical berry, the fairy berry! It makes a custom item, fairy berry punch, in the keg, and it makes fairy dust in the recycling machine. It also makes sugar in the mill. It grows in the summer and takes 20 days to grow. The seeds are purchasable from the Travelling Cart in summer only. 

Credits:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5221]6480's Giant Crops[/url] by  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/55537262]6480[/url] for the giant crop sprite which I recolored.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4912]Better Crops and Foraging[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5394]Better Artisan Goods[/url] by  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/38715215]cometkins[/url] which I recolored.

Thank you to both of these artists for allowing me to use their assets!
